value.value: The cited starting wurtzite CdSe belts are five monolayers thick. Hypothetical unreconstructed top/bottom and long-edge facets are nonpolar, with four-coordinate valley atoms and three-coordinate ridge atoms before ligation. This is a cited structural model, not a new product refinement.
